saints.name: Brother André
saints.summary: Little Alfred Bessette, born at St. Grégoire, Quebec on August 9, 1845, had his roots in our own soil. The future Saint Brother Andrew of Mount Royal was a son of this land and of the French Canadian family.

saints.name: Wulfran
saints.legacy: A compassionate missionary and miracle worker.
saints.summary: Saint Wulfran was an Archbishop of Sens who renounced worldly greatness to serve God and the Church. He became a missionary in Friesland, where he baptized many and performed miracles, including saving a boy from sacrifice. His efforts helped to establish Christianity in a pagan land, and he is remembered for his compassion and dedication to the faith.
